problems.problem: The 'single crisp horizontal boundary' reads as three stacked flat bands: a faint translucent gold strip (~y1099-1147) sits above the 50% gold field, softening the decisive edge and making the ground look like layered vector rectangles rather than one honed mineral plane meeting air.
problems.root_cause: Extra low-opacity rectangle (y1099, h48, opacity 0.16) plus the 0.5-opacity gold field produce a stepped, diagrammatic horizon instead of one crisp material boundary.
problems.repair_strategy: Reduce background.shapes to two rectangles only - ivory air field (0,0,1080,1123) and a single warmer, higher-opacity gold ground (0,1123,1080,317, e.g. #D9A441 at opacity 0.85) - so one crisp edge passes behind the base; keep the empty two-plane material prompt unchanged.

problems.problem: The typographic declaration is small and timid (44px mark, 64px title) in a large empty sky; versus the legacy reference's monumental house lettering, the lockup reads as a caption block rather than the 'monumental declaration confronting a small object' half of the concept.
problems.root_cause: Type sizes and tracking were set conservatively for safety instead of using the available upper-left sky as an active field.
problems.repair_strategy: Raise logo to ~72-80px and title to ~88-96px with tracking 4-6, keep left alignment at x~80-86 and current vertical order (logo, title, rule, subtitle); verify no collision with the bottle silhouette (bottle left edge x~713) and no canvas clipping.

problems.problem: The contact shade reads as a soft gray halo hugging the base sides on the ivory side of the horizon; on a ground plane whose boundary is at base level, the shade should pool slightly onto the gold field to anchor the bottle physically.
problems.root_cause: Symmetric zero-offset contact shadow rendered behind the base rather than a bounded cast patch on the declared ground.
problems.repair_strategy: Keep the soft contact shadow but add a bounded external cast patch on the gold plane: integration_plan cast_length_ratio ~0.05, cast_opacity ~0.25, cast_blur ~12, centered under the base so the shade sits on the gold field; preserve observed frontal key light.

critique.product: Unmodified packshot preserved: peach-champagne juice, ribbed gold collar, clear sphere stopper, gold serif label and bright opaque white base refraction all match image 2; no duplicate, no relighting damage, no label invention. Height ratio 0.5597 sits inside the 0.50-0.65 hero band and the fresh-concept policy range.
critique.contact: Inspected the supplied contact crop before judging: a short soft contact shade sits directly under the narrow white base at y≈1122 with offset_y=0; the base rests exactly on the ivory-to-gold boundary with the faint 48px accent band centering the meeting line - no floating, shadow parameters correct and left untouched.
critique.composition: The previous round's mis-set horizon is resolved: the ivory sky now ends and the champagne-gold ground begins precisely at the base line, so the asymmetric editorial lockup (Didone mark, 64px serif CJK declaration, gold rule, subtitle) stacks left in the calm sky while the bottle alone occupies the plane. Margins comfortable, hierarchy clear, and the 22% gold ground gives the frame a confident color-field weight comparable to the legacy J'adore print.
critique.typography: Serif CJK (simsun) gives the declaration a literary luxury voice matching the Didone logo; bronze ink holds strong contrast on both light fields; tracking 3/1/4px keeps airy spacing; no overlap with product (all overlap booleans false).
critique.background: Two perfectly smooth matte tinted planes with one crisp horizontal boundary and a subtle lighter accent band at the meeting line; no stone figure, veining, blotches, streaks, props or studio equipment. The boundary now coincides with the product base as the concept demands, and the soft frontal illumination matches the unmodified packshot.
critique.references: Echoes the legacy J'adore golden-field equity (house lettering left, bottle right, warm monochrome ground) and the architectural calm of the Prada reference without imitation; the resolved horizon event lifts the poster to reference caliber while remaining renderer-safe abstraction.
critique.coherence: Palette #F4EDE1/#4B3413/#D9A441, copy about light meeting earth, single soft contact shade and the smooth two-field atmosphere all express 'The Golden Hour Plane'; the horizon placement, grounding and typography now agree with the declared direction, so no internal contradiction remains.
